# REYRUN Recursive Deep Search

[Latviski](https://reyrun-rekursive-deep-search.runcisreinis.chatgpt.site/index.lv) · [English](https://reyrun-rekursive-deep-search.runcisreinis.chatgpt.site/) · [Русский](https://reyrun-rekursive-deep-search.runcisreinis.chatgpt.site/index.ru)

## What is recursive deep search?

The first result suggests what to look for next. Your chat checks what it finds, saves notes in a folder about what worked and what didn’t, and reads them next time.

Reinis Runcis built this skill so your chat can dig deeper on its own and look for solutions that might not come to mind at first.

A single deep search works in the chat alone. To build on past searches, your chat must be able to reopen the same folder. If it can’t, use [Reinis’s bridge to your computer](https://reyrun-chatbot-bridge.runcisreinis.chatgpt.site/en/).

The skill is completely free to install and use. Try it. If it works for you, keep using it. If you want something to work differently, ask your chat to adapt it.

Paste the [project website](https://reyrun-rekursive-deep-search.runcisreinis.chatgpt.site/) into your AI chat and ask your question.
